_help: Which pad button does what. The stick aims (or, with the cue ball in hand, moves it). Actions: shoot (hold for power, let go to shoot), cancel (drop the shot; with the ball in hand, pick the cue ball up again), spin (tap: the next spin; hold with the stick: move the tip), camera (behind the cue or overhead), fineLeft and fineRight (tiny turns of the aim), place (put the cue ball down).
